scope: macOS 13+ Apple Silicon native entropy and peer-identity wrappers

symbols.behavior: Uses Apple's documented NULL default provider; accepts 0..=256 bytes; empty input is a no-op; nonzero OSStatus clears the complete output before returning the status.
Returns Darwin real user ID using the SDK uid_t ABI (u32).
Borrows the descriptor only during the synchronous call; returns Darwin uid_t/gid_t as u32; captures thread-local errno immediately on failure.

abi_evidence.sdk: Local MacOSX.sdk: SecRandom.h, unistd.h, sys/_types.h, sys/errno.h
facts: SecRandomRef is an opaque pointer and NULL selects the documented default.
SecRandomCopyBytes takes size_t and void * and returns int; zero is success.
Darwin uid_t and gid_t alias unsigned 32-bit types.
getpeereid takes int, uid_t *, gid_t *; __error returns the calling thread's errno slot.

api_adaptations: peer_credentials accepts BorrowedFd to make descriptor lifetime explicit and returns the uid/gid pair as a tuple.
SystemError distinguishes random OSStatus, captured peer-credential errno, and an over-limit request with requested/maximum sizes.
Empty entropy requests return success without calling the native API.
security_boundary: Only src/sys.rs permits unsafe code. Native calls are synchronous, retain no pointers/descriptors, and do not dispatch work to another thread. No unsupported-OS implementation is included.
not_claimed: AppKit, windowing, graphics, file dialogs, or other platform services
